title: The Attending Physician
paragraphs: “If there’s a problem, Yggdrasil medicine can handle most of it.”

Yes, if anything goes wrong, we can rely on the medicine that Father always uses. The ingredients are a bit special, but I think I can make it as well. There are various variants of that medicine. Although slightly less effective, there’s also a medicine called Phoenix Life, and in the worst-case scenario, there’s a medicine called Dragon Blood. Both are extremely effective, and most illnesses can be cured instantly with these. The former is rare, but the latter can be made from dragon materials.
“Come to think of it, it’s amazing that just taking medicine can cure most diseases, isn’t it?”
“Well, in Japan where I was from, medicine didn’t cure colds, it just relieved the symptoms… But hearing that from Itsuki feels a bit off.”
“Why is that?”
“It’s a world where there’s healing abilities, right? You’d think any cold could be cured easily.”
When Ren said that to Itsuki, he replied with a slightly exasperated look.
“Well, yes, there are abilities like that… but that’s a separate matter. What about you, Ren?”
“In the past, dangerous viral diseases could be cured if you went to the hospital. I learned they could suppress the virus’s growth.”
“Ah… I think I saw something similar on the news before being summoned. So in Ren’s world, that’s already practical?”
I’ve heard something similar before. It seems that science has advanced to a level close to that of this world’s medicines.
“Either way, it’s probably a good idea to have Sakura and Gaelion checked. Yggdrasil medicine, right? There might be diseases it can’t handle.”
“Understood.”
“Well, it seems like a good idea to go before we depart.”
“We’re allowed to leave first, right?”
“Yeah. Alright, Ren, Itsuki, see you again in the evening.”
After finishing our meal, Ren and Itsuki returned to their respective places where they had anchored their airships via portal. By the way, Éclair went with Ren.
“Alright, Motoyasu. Let’s go get Sakura and Gaelion checked.”
“Understood, Father. Shall we have everyone examined while we’re at it?”
“Huh? Sakura and the others were already examined in their human forms, right? We’re going now to check their monster forms.”
I looked at my assistant and the mole.
“Um, Motoyasu… Don’t tell me you’re considering Windia and Imia as monsters too?”
Hmm? Isn’t that the case? I can understand the assistant, but I think the mole should be included, right?
“Haah… Motoyasu, you’re still a bit off in your judgment. Well, I guess it’s because Yuki and the others can take on different forms.”
“Hehe, that’s right!”
“That’s nothing to be proud of, okay?”
“Nano!”
“There’s no need to compete.”

Father seems to be lamenting something. What could he be lamenting about? I will eliminate the cause for him. As we talked, we were guided to a school in Faubrey that housed a famous alchemy institution. It somehow reminds me of a university. The building has a Western-style atmosphere. We were taken to a section that felt like a zoo, filled with many monsters.
“There are so many different kinds of monsters.”
“Yeah.”

My assistant’s eyes are sparkling. Come to think of it, the assistant likes monsters. It seems that even monsters I haven’t seen before are being raised here. In that sense, it wouldn’t be wrong to call it a rare beast zoo.
“Please wait a moment.”

The person dispatched from the castle guided us through this rare beast zoo and into a mansion-like building, then went to call the relevant personnel. Strange creatures were floating inside capsules, making a gurgling sound.
Should I call them large test tubes?
“I thought it was more like a zoo, but this place really gives off that otherworldly feeling.”
“Nano?”
“Hmm? Smells like medicine.”
“Yeah, it does smell like that.”
“I’ve seen something like this in a movie with pigs before. A mad scientist crossed the line into the realm of gods, and then a ferocious monster went on a rampage.”
“This place’s decor makes that scenario feel way too real, though.”
“There’s also a pattern where zombies and other undead show up, isn’t there?”
“That’s why it doesn’t sound like a joke, okay?”

Father keeps pointing that out to me. Well, even if a giant snake or shark showed up, I wouldn’t be scared. I just dealt with undead-type zombies not long ago. Though in Melromarc, they weren’t zombies but demons.
“Motoyasu, you’re making me feel anxious now. Sakura, Gaelion, don’t stray too far from me, okay?”
Father gave a warning.
Wouldn’t that only be necessary for Sakura?
“Nano?”
“Why?”
“Because if not, you might get disassembled and modified.”
“Scary!”
“It’s okay, nano! Gaelion won’t die from just being disassembled!”
Sakura-chan’s reaction is adorable. But my rival…
What’s with that reaction? And the assistant… doesn’t look worried at all?
“Windia-chan, are you okay? You don’t have to worry, alright?”
“Yeah. You know, I just asked the monsters here, and it seems like the person in charge here is a good person, so there’s nothing to worry about.”
Oh? Is it because she can understand the monsters’ language that she feels reassured?
“Really?”
“Yeah. They seemed to trust that person a lot, kind of like how Gaelion admires the Shield Hero.”
“Huh… then I guess there’s no problem.”
“Yeah. They also said they’re staying here because they want to get stronger.”
Hearing that, Father slowly looked at the assistant and broke into a cold sweat.
“That’s actually making me more anxious.”
“Huh?”
The assistant doesn’t seem to understand why Father suddenly got anxious. This ties back to what I’ve been saying. From the monsters’ perspective, they’re here because they can become stronger.
But once they get stronger, will they go on a rampage? Eventually, the sound of footsteps echoed, and the door of the room where we were waiting opened.
“I heard you’re letting me examine the special monsters raised by the Hero?”
“Huh?”
Father turned toward the voice and stared. There stood…
“Ah, I should introduce myself first, right? Umm, Shield Hero and Spear Hero… and your companions, I suppose? My name is Ratotil=Ansleiya. People close to me just call me Rat.”
“This person!”
“Motoyasu-kun, do you know her?”
“She’s the attending physician!”

There’s no mistake. She’s the leading authority on monsters who worked with Father and the assistant, examining not only the Filolials but also various other monsters in the village under Father’s domain. She’s also Filo-tan’s attending physician and conducted research with Father on many things. I trusted her skills as a physician.
“What’s going on here?”
“Um… Rat-san, do you know about the circumstances of us Four Holy Heroes?”
“Unfortunately, I’ve been too busy with research to keep up with that.”
The attending physician scratched her head lazily. That figure in the lab coat is undoubtedly the physician herself.
“So? Are these the unusual monsters you’re talking about?”
The attending physician quickly started examining the Filolials.
“W-What is this!?”
“Wa-wa-wah! Kuu is scared!”
“Fuwa fuwa~”
“Hmm? From what I can feel, these creatures have definitely undergone some kind of transformation. Show me your true form.”

Somehow, she buried her hand into the Filolials’ feathers and seemed to manipulate something. With a poof, the Filolials were forcibly reverted to their original forms. I’d like to know how she does that.
Chapter 675 – Examination
“Whoa… that was fast. I guess it tickled?”
“There’s a lot more feathers than the average Filolial. The bone structure seems quite different too… Open your mouth.”
“P-Please stop it!”
Yuki-chan struggled and tried to lightly kick the attending physician, but the doctor seemed to anticipate her joint movements and narrowly dodged, forcibly grabbing her beak and prying it open.
“Ah…”
“Don’t struggle.”
Then, with smooth precision, the doctor inserted a syringe into her mouth and injected the medicine.

W-What refined technique is this? Every time I witness this, I am amazed by the skill in restraining Filolials who resist examinations. Against familiar opponents, the doctor can subdue them without even using medication. Even the Filolials I raised initially resisted and had to be subdued with medicine, but by the third time, they were held down with joint techniques alone. I even taught this to the assistant, and I remember how efficiently they handled it.
“Ah… Motoyasu-sama…”
Yuki-chan looked at me with pleading eyes. When I saw that gaze, there was only one course of action for me to take.
“I’m coming now!”
“Uh… um…”
Father stood frozen, observing the scene.
“You can’t move. I can’t conduct a proper diagnosis if you do.”
“Motoyasu-sama…”
I grabbed Yuki-chan’s wing to reassure her. I bet my rival probably thought I was going to kill the doctor. Unfortunately, I’m not that impulsive. More importantly, I can trust the doctor.
However…
“If you paralyze my precious Filolials any further with medicine, I won’t forgive you!”
“Ah, yes, yes. Hmm… I see… So that’s how it is. I’ll just take a feather and some blood for genetic analysis…”
The doctor skillfully examined the immobilized Yuki-chan and conducted various tests.
“Yuki-chan, just a little more patience. You’ll be fine in no time.”
“U-Understood!”
It took about two minutes, I believe? The effects of the medicine wore off from Yuki-chan.
“Motoyasu-sama!”
Yuki-chan quickly stood up and hid behind me as her shield. She endured it well. I hugged Yuki-chan and gently stroked her head.
“Oh? The medicine wore off faster than expected. Well, whatever. The examination is over. She’s in excellent health.”
The doctor was already searching for Kou as the next target.
“Hm? Where is Kou?”
“He ran away. So did Sakura-chan.”
Father was watching the direction in which Kou and Sakura-chan had escaped.
“Father, you must not let them escape. This is the attending physician, and they will give a proper examination.”
“Uh…”
“I’m scared, na! I feel like they’re really reliable, but there’s this fear that I can’t move at all, na!”
“Amazing…”
My rival, in dragon form, was clinging to Father. With this, even Father couldn’t hold Sakura-chan back.
“What exactly is this ‘attending physician’? I’m an alchemist and a researcher, you know?”
“Um… it’s complicated, but… how should I put this? Motoyasu-kun is… kind of from the future.”
Father explained my situation to the attending physician. Whether they believed it or not, I could not say.
“So, what you’re saying is… in another possible world, I’ve already met the heroes?”
“That’s correct. Motoyasu-kun usually can’t perceive normal women as women, but since he recognizes Rato-san, that means she had a special relationship with him.”
“In the future, she served as the attending physician for Filo-tan and many other Filolials, I say.”
I also remember her managing the monsters in Father’s territory, as well as assisting me. I’m surprised to find her in a place like this.
“Hmm…”
The attending physician responded, seemingly uninterested.
“I get the story. Either way, you’re going to let me examine that dragon over there too, right?”
“Ah, yes. As long as you do a proper examination… preferably without using any medicine.”
“If they don’t struggle, I’ll take a look.”
“Uh… you’re not going to say something like, ‘I won’t know unless I take them apart,’ right?”
“What would be the point of killing them…?”

I remembered that Father had once mentioned that while the attending physician seemed a bit crazy, they were actually quite sensible. In other words, this place was the attending physician’s research lab. That means this is a trustworthy place.
“Okay, now stick out your tongue… Yes, yes, open your mouth wide.”
“Na—”

My rival opened their mouth wide and showed their tongue to the attending physician. After examining my rival’s mouth, the physician checked inside and then grabbed their stomach with their left hand while reaching deep into their throat with their right hand.
“Ugh… ugh…”
Father and the assistant were watching anxiously.
“Um, maybe don’t overdo it…”
“There’s a mixed attribute reaction in the breath sack and a strange response in the magic organ. I wonder if it’s because this is a monster raised by a hero?”

The attending physician muttered something while withdrawing their hand and checking my rival’s eyes, cheeks, and horns. My rival seemed to dislike being touched, but compared to having a hand shoved into their mouth, they preferred to endure by clinging to Father.
“Well, I guess that’s about it? There’s no particular problem. I’ve made some discoveries, but there’s no major illness.”
“Ah… I see.”
“Hmm… there’s a slight irregular flow of magic.”
The attending physician took a piece of paper nearby and began writing something like a medical record.
Impressive. I’m starting to want to be able to perform health checks on Filolials anytime myself.
“Is there something wrong with Gaelion?”
The assistant asked the attending physician anxiously. The physician responded with a light smile to reassure them.
“It’s not that. For now, it’s just at the observation stage. Filolials are somewhat similar in that regard.”
“Na, na… Naofumi, I want you to pet me, na.”
“Ah, yes, yes. You did well holding on.”
Father gently stroked my rival.
“I endured, na! I’m better than Sakura who ran away, na!”
“Mmm…”

Oh? Sakura-chan and the others had returned and were making dissatisfied noises in front of the room door. But I have something to say. Sakura-chan and the others just have a higher sense of danger avoidance.
“Um, so, is there something strange going on with Gaelion-chan?”

“I’ve only skimmed through the research materials on dragons, but… speaking isn’t an issue. It’s been reported that purebred species called Dragon Emperors can speak, so that’s nothing to worry about.”
“Ah… okay.”
“Changes in the vocal cords are also within expectations. It’s the same with Filolials. Filolials can learn human language if you teach them, so there’s no need to worry about that.”
However, the attending physician scratched their head with a pen.
“Now, here’s the main issue. There’s a strange reaction around the magic core and the heart… it’s as if two living beings have been forcibly—”
“Gya, gyau—na, na!”
My rival let out a loud cry, cutting off the attending physician’s words. The attending physician looked annoyed at being interrupted.
“Sis, have Naofumi listen to the story. Gaelion and the others will go outside to watch the monsters, na.”
“Huh? But…”
My rival desperately whispered something into Father’s ear.
“Yeah, I’ll listen to it. Everything looks fine, so you can go. Imia-chan, please go with them.”
“Ah, okay.”
The assistant and the Mole, who had been quiet until now, left the room with my rival.
“Um, so…?”

“To continue… it looks as though two living beings have been forcibly fused while remaining conscious… but that’s not it. It seems like they’re far more compatible… as if they were designed to be like that from the start.”

What!? I already knew the attending physician was skilled, but they deduced all that just from a physical examination and checking the internal organs through the mouth without using any advanced equipment? I truly believe they are a genius.
“I thought it might be a parasitic monster, but it’s a little different. However, there’s definitely something inside that child. I’d recommend removing it.”
“Um… I don’t think that’s a problem, so please don’t worry about it.”
“Oh? Since this is a health check, I think it’s something worth discussing.”
“Well… since Motoyasu-kun seems to trust you, I’ll explain. Inside that Gaelion-chan is—”
Father explained that my rival was the Dragon Emperor and that, furthermore, the assistant’s guardian was inside my rival’s body. A kind of pseudo-dual personality.
